subject: general
question: Which one of the following diseases is NOT caused by a virus?
solution:
The correct answer is **Tuberculosis**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tuberculosis** is caused by a bacterium called *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*.
 
• Unlike the other diseases listed, it is not caused by a virus.
 
• Tuberculosis primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body.
 
• The other options (Influenza, Chicken Pox, Measles) are all viral diseases.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 2: Influenza
 Caused by the Influenza virus, it affects the respiratory system.
 
 

 Option 3: Chicken Pox
 Caused by the Varicella-zoster virus, it leads to an itchy rash with red spots and blisters.
 
 

 Option 4: Measles
 Caused by the Measles virus, it results in a red, blotchy skin rash and flu-like symptoms.
